items.title: Sebi examining position limits for non-agri contracts to boost liquidity
items.description: Sebi is examining position limits for non-agricultural commodity contracts to improve liquidity and market depth while maintaining risk controls, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said

items.title: Sebi to soon issue framework on CAS; receives over 3,500 comments
items.description: Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said the market regulator would quickly examine responses to its consultation paper on changes to CAS, market timings and settlement of derivative contracts
